name: Mei Ling Tan
bio:
Mei Ling Tan has been ensuring the smooth operation of catering services in high-pressure environments for over 20 years. Starting her career in a bustling hawker center in Singapore, she quickly learned the importance of efficiency, quality, and meeting exacting standards. Her transition into motorsport came unexpectedly when a friend, working as a mechanic for a local racing team, mentioned their need for a reliable catering manager. Intrigued by the fast-paced and demanding nature of racing, Mei Ling took the leap and never looked back.

At Trident, Mei Ling is known for her uncompromising commitment to providing nutritious and delicious meals to the team, no matter the logistical challenges. She believes that a well-fed team is a high-performing team, and she takes pride in sourcing the freshest ingredients and adapting her menus to suit the diverse dietary needs of the crew. Her meticulous attention to detail and insistence on impeccable hygiene have earned her the respect of the entire team. She is particularly known for her insistence on fresh fruit and her homemade kaya toast that keeps the team going even during the longest race weekends.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled in a short, practical bob
physical.description: Mei Ling is a petite woman with a warm smile and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Insists on using only locally sourced ingredients, even when traveling internationally
Always carries a small tin of ginger sweets for anyone feeling unwell
Has a habit of rearranging the cutlery in the team's dining area to ensure perfect symmetry
